name: iConvert Optimizer
author: Extend Themes

sections.description:
iConvert Optimizer lets you run A/B split tests on WordPress pages without writing a single line of code.

Create multiple variations of a page, define how traffic is distributed between them, choose your success metric, and let the plugin do the rest. Clear statistics show you exactly which variation is winning.

Key Features

  • A/B test WordPress pages — run split tests on any page.
  • Button click conversion goals — measure what matters: track button clicks to determine which variation drives more engagement.
  • Smart traffic splitting — set the percentage for each variation and the plugin automatically keeps the actual served ratio on target.
  • Instant results dashboard — see impressions, conversions, and conversion rates per variation at a glance.
  • Scheduling — set a start and end date for a test, or run it manually.
  • Role-based exclusion — prevent specific user roles (e.g. administrators) from being entered into a test.
  • One-click variation duplication — duplicate any page to create a new variation instantly.
  • Live preview — preview any variation in context without affecting live traffic.
sections.faq:
Does this plugin work with the Block Editor (Gutenberg)?

Yes. iConvert Optimizer fully supports the Block Editor and block themes. You can A/B test any WordPress page built with Gutenberg.

How is traffic split between variations?

You assign a percentage to each variation. The plugin tracks daily display counts per variation and always serves the one that is furthest behind its target percentage, so the actual served ratio converges on your configured split over time.

Will visitors always see the same variation?

Yes. Once a visitor has been assigned a variation, their assignment is stored in a session cookie. They will continue to see the same variation for the duration of the test.

Can I exclude logged-in users or administrators from tests?

Yes. In the test editor you can select one or more WordPress user roles to exclude from the test. Excluded users will always see the original (control) page.

Where can I find the source code?

The complete source code for this plugin is available on GitHub: https://github.com/extendthemes/iconvert-optimizer-public
